lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in loose horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with a prominent vertical column of four bright spots located immediately behind the upper gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting several of the high-luminance blobs to create a rudimentary grid structure on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear horizontal feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity transition from light (dorsal) to dark (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated shapes (remoras) positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin; a single, distinct, thin horizontal line of high luminance is visible on the mid-flank posterior to the gills.
